paragraphs: The X1 xDrive23i is part of the third-generation U11 X1 range, introduced in 2022. It uses the B48 — a 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-four petrol engine that's part of BMW's modern modular B-series family. The B48 is widely regarded as a robust, well-engineered unit, sharing its core architecture with the three-cylinder B38 and six-cylinder B58.
about.boldParagraph: The X1 xDrive23i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
